prompt: Which property of a white dwarf explains its position at the bottom left of the HR diagram?
markscheme: **B.** Hot (left) yet dim (bottom) requires a small surface area.

prompt: Star P has a parallax angle twice that of star Q. Both have the same luminosity. What is $\tfrac{\text{apparent brightness of P}}{\text{apparent brightness of Q}}$?
markscheme: **D.** $d \propto 1/p$, so P is half as far; $b \propto 1/d^2$ gives 4 times the brightness.
